title: AXI4 Write: Independent AW, W, and B Channels
description: Trace a three-beat write where W data reaches the interface before the AW address is accepted, both channels absorb backpressure independently, and the B response waits for the accepted address and final data beat.

annotations.message: The first W beat transfers while AWREADY is LOW. AXI allows write data to appear at an interface before its write address is accepted.
The AW handshake accepts ID 3, address 0x100, and AWLEN=2. WREADY is LOW, so D1 begins a separate W-channel stall.
AW is already complete, but the W channel remains stalled. WVALID, WDATA=D1, WSTRB, and WLAST must stay stable.
WREADY returns HIGH and accepts D1. The AW channel did not need to wait for this W-channel progress.
D2 transfers with WLAST=1, completing the three-beat W burst. Both AXI4 response prerequisites—accepted AW and final W—are now satisfied.
The slave offers BID=3 and BRESP=OKAY, but BREADY is LOW. The response remains valid and stable under backpressure.
The B handshake accepts the write response. Only this edge completes the write transaction from the master's point of view.
